title: The set of points where the fibres are unramified is compatible with arbitrary base change
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma says that for a locally finite type morphism the set of points where the fibres are unramified is the preimage of the corresponding set under any base change, with the same statement for the G-unramified locus when the morphism is locally of finite presentation (statement lines 7937-7955). The counted proof is short and complete: it identifies the fibres of the base change as base changes of the fibres, compares the relative differentials through the cited base change statement, applies the pointwise characterization of unramifiedness to translate this into the equality of the point sets, and adds the G-unramified variant using the corresponding characterization (proof lines 7957-7977). It is H2: the comparison and both conclusions are carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being the fibre, differential and unramifiedness statements.
